SELECT u.* FROM sys_user u WHERE u.deleted = 0
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.username}, '%')
AND u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.realName}, '%')
AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.phone}, '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.role_key = #{query.roleKey})
AND u.status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC, u.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabled, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS disabled, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.user_id) FROM sys_user_role x INNER JOIN sys_role r2 ON r2.id = x.role_id AND r2.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u2 ON u2.id = x.user_id AND u2.deleted = 0 WHERE r2.role_key = 'DOCTOR') AS doctor FROM sys_user u WHERE u.deleted = 0
